The brief

From a blank sheet to a drivable MVP

Toyota's question evolved from "what vehicle should we build?" to "what ecosystem does this vehicle need to succeed?" RIFT led on-the-ground, human-centred design with ED² and delivered a working answer — fast, locally, collaboratively.

EV platform prototyped and field-tested in Kenya
Mobility-as-a-Service: vehicle + services + hub + operations
Concept to field-tested prototype & service blueprint in under 2 years
// IMV Origin · field prototype
01 · Human-centred design

Designed with African users, not for them

User and ecosystem research across rural and peri-urban Kenya shaped every decision — from real farmers, traders and mechanics to transport operators and fleet owners.

Agri tradersFood businessesMarket operatorsSACCOsMatatu ownersK-Truck usersMechanicsRural fleets
Mobility benchmarking — Roam, Arc Ride, Spiro; local assemblers Mobius & KVM
Value-chain mapping across agriculture, logistics, construction, courier
Service-hub concept: assembly, charging, operator training, rural grid
Integration with existing networks — matatus, SACCOs, local logistics
// Chassis development · 2024
02 · Chassis development

Hands-on vehicle experiments

RIFT began with reference vehicles found on Kenyan roads — ProBox, Hiace and K-Trucks — and built up from there.

Modified a Suzuki Carry / Daihatsu Hijet — lifted suspension, reinforced structure — as a field-test platform
ProBox-derived chassis build (first prototype) and a Hiace prototype
Stripped-down K-Truck chassis with a tubular IMV Origin mock-up
03 · Electric powertrain

A complete electric drive, built from scratch

Building on RIFT's SONGA 3-wheeler EV experience, the team engineered a full electric drivetrain for the truck platform.

Tested e-Axle (selected) vs hub-motors; integrated controllers, power electronics & custom wiring harness
New control systems (throttle, regen braking), fabricated battery bay, re-engineered rear suspension for rough terrain
Custom power & GPS-logging IoT for performance monitoring
~10 km/kWh — validated on a 120 km Naivasha → Nairobi run and off-road. A frugal, reliable EV powertrain, fully engineered in Kenya.
// Locally fabricated · Nairobi
04 · Show-car prototype · mid-2025

A fully drivable, bespoke prototype

A

Made in Kenya

Fully fabricated with locally CNC-machined metal parts, hand-in-hand with ED².

B

Custom powertrain

Bespoke e-Axle integration; battery bay & suspension engineered on the fly from local K-Truck components.

C

Drive-by-wire

No compatible steering column — so a full drive-by-wire system was developed from scratch.

D

Regen braking

Braking improvised using motor regenerative control in place of mechanical brakes.

A fully functional, drivable IMV Origin — enabling field tests, stakeholder demos and film shoots for the Japan Mobility Show 2025.
05 · Ecosystem & service

Not just a vehicle — an ecosystem

Hub architecture

ED² × Shigeru Ban Architects × RIFT

A modular, low-cost, expandable hub for rural deployment — integrating charging, maintenance, training and community services. Developed 2024–2025 as a functional prototype.

Service & platform

RIFT × ARK Africa × Antarctica Global

Prototyped digital platforms — operator tools, service workflows, data flows — with an ecosystem narrative aligned to the IMV Origin vision.

Outcome: a fully defined service concept and platform architecture, ready for field testing, iteration and scale.
